item.tib: tshe dbang gsang ba yang zhun gyi sad srung mtha' sel
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas/ nges med sprang po drung mu wer ro la/ gyim shod shel brag tu/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga la snyan du brgyud/ mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ dad ldan grogs po'i (pos) bskul ba'i ngor/ zab mo dben pa'i ri khrod du/ dkar chag yi ger ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol//
